correctness.rationale: The exact normalized monomial ratio is w_A(m,k)^2=hβ((Aν)_1)hβ((Aν)_2)/[hβ(m)hβ(k)], hβ(j)=Γ(β+2)Γ(j+1)/Γ(j+β+2). Nonsingular A gives orthogonal images of distinct columns. The essential norm is limsup of weights at escaping ν; gamma asymptotics make unbalanced rays vanish for δ>0 and on ratio t=m/k>0 minimize ((ut+v)(wt+s))/t, yielding (√(us)+√(vw))^-δ for B=A^n. Perron asymptotics give the exact essential radius ρ(A)^-δ and sharp Θ rate on the nonconstant subspace. Strict positivity gives |Aν|_1≥2|ν|_1, so lattice monomials decompose into infinitely many rooted one-sided A-orbits; shift weights approach ρ(A)^-δ, yielding an adjoint eigenvector on each chain for every interior λ, a non-Fredholm disk, and no spectrum outside by power bounds. The constant block adds eigenvalue 1; Hardy δ=0 has weights identically 1 and norm 1 for all powers. A separate independent finite low-degree moment/essential comparison for A=[[1,1],[1,2]] corroborated weights and boundary behavior, but spectral and infinite essential-norm claims rely on the proof.
